# Functions {-}


```{r echo=FALSE}
## Define  interaction table functions {-}

compact_emm_table <- function(emm_object,
                              by_var,
                              condition_prefix = NULL,
                              reverse = FALSE,      # TRUE = later level minus earlier (revpairwise)
                              adjust = NULL,        # NULL = emmeans default; e.g. "none", "tukey", "holm"
                              digits_est = 2,
                              digits_df = 1,
                              digits_p = 3,
                              digits_by = 2) {      # decimals shown for numeric by-values (e.g. OS, LP)

  emm_df <- summary(emm_object) |> as.data.frame()

  # by_var can be one bare name (by_var = OS) or several (by_var = c(family_size, OS))
  by_names <- names(tidyselect::eval_select(rlang::enquo(by_var), emm_df))

  contrast_df <- if (is.null(adjust)) {
    pairs(emm_object, reverse = reverse)
  } else {
    pairs(emm_object, reverse = reverse, adjust = adjust)
  }
  contrast_df <- contrast_df |> summary() |> as.data.frame()

  # Exclude BOTH Satterthwaite/KR-style and asymptotic-style CI/df column names
  non_focal_cols <- c(by_names, "emmean", "SE", "df",
                      "lower.CL", "upper.CL",
                      "asymp.LCL", "asymp.UCL")
  focal_vars <- setdiff(names(emm_df), non_focal_cols)

  # Detect whichever CI column names are actually present
  lcl_col <- intersect(c("lower.CL", "asymp.LCL"), names(emm_df))
  ucl_col <- intersect(c("upper.CL", "asymp.UCL"), names(emm_df))

  # Condition label: a bare value (single by-variable, no prefix, as before),
  # "prefix = value" (single by-variable with prefix), or
  # "name = value, name = value" (several by-variables)
  fmt_by <- function(x) {
    if (is.numeric(x)) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digits_by) else as.character(x)
  }
  make_condition <- function(df) {
    if (length(by_names) == 1) {
      v <- fmt_by(df[[by_names]])
      if (is.null(condition_prefix)) v else paste(condition_prefix, "=", v)
    } else {
      parts <- lapply(by_names, function(n) paste(n, "=", fmt_by(df[[n]])))
      do.call(paste, c(parts, sep = ", "))
    }
  }

  emm_part <- emm_df |>
    rowwise() |>
    mutate(Comparison = paste(c_across(all_of(focal_vars)), collapse = " ")) |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(Condition = make_condition(pick(everything()))) |>
    transmute(
      across(all_of(by_names)),          # kept temporarily for sorting
      Comparison,
      Condition,
      Estimate = emmean,
      SE,
      df,
      lower.CL = if (length(lcl_col) > 0) .data[[lcl_col]] else NA_real_,
      upper.CL = if (length(ucl_col) > 0) .data[[ucl_col]] else NA_real_,
      t.ratio = NA_real_,
      p.value = NA_real_
    )

  # Detect whichever test-statistic column name is present (t.ratio vs z.ratio)
  ratio_col <- intersect(c("t.ratio", "z.ratio"), names(contrast_df))

  contrast_part <- contrast_df |>
    mutate(Comparison = as.character(contrast),
           Condition  = make_condition(pick(everything()))) |>
    transmute(
      across(all_of(by_names)),
      Comparison,
      Condition,
      Estimate = estimate,
      SE,
      df,
      lower.CL = NA_real_,
      upper.CL = NA_real_,
      t.ratio = if (length(ratio_col) > 0) .data[[ratio_col]] else NA_real_,
      p.value
    )

  # Sort by the by-variables' actual values (numeric order for OS/LP, level
  # order for factors), not by the text label, then drop them
  bind_rows(emm_part, contrast_part) |>
    arrange(across(all_of(by_names)), Comparison) |>
    select(-all_of(by_names)) |>
    mutate(
      Estimate = round(Estimate, digits_est),
      SE       = round(SE, digits_est),
      df       = round(df, digits_df),
      lower.CL = round(lower.CL, digits_est),
      upper.CL = round(upper.CL, digits_est),
      t.ratio  = round(t.ratio, digits_est),
      p.value  = round(p.value, digits_p)
    )
}
```

```{r }
# =============================================================================
# m21_ldt -- refit all nonword analyses after applying the LDT exclusions
#   Excluded: S130, S132, S133 (over age); S137, S157 (English not native);
#             S140 (no responses to experimental nonwords)
#   Expected samples: RT N = 62, ERP N = 60 (RT sample minus S103, S165: no EEG)
#
# Files needed in the working directory:
#   rt_nwords_frq.csv, erp_fs_dmg.csv, demo_lang_vsl_pca_hc.csv,
#   rt_data_hc_A.csv, rt_data_hc_B_fixed.csv
#
# All printed output is also written to refit_option1_output.txt
# =============================================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)
library(effectsize)    # eta_squared()
library(performance)   # r2_nakagawa()

emm_options(lmer.df = "satterthwaite", lmerTest.limit = 20000)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Switch: keep the existing PCA scores (computed on 68 participants), or rerun
# the PCA on the analysed sample (N = 62). Run once with each setting if you
# want to compare.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
rerun_pca <- TRUE   # chosen version: PCA rerun on the analysed sample (N = 62)

excluded <- c("S130", "S132", "S133", "S137", "S157", "S140")

sink("refit_option1_output.txt", split = TRUE)
cat("rerun_pca =", rerun_pca, "\n")

hdr <- function(x) cat("\n\n", strrep("=", 75), "\n", x, "\n", strrep("=", 75), "\n", sep = "")

```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# 1. PCA scores
# =============================================================================
demo <- read_csv("CSV_FILES/demo_lang_vsl_pca_hc.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(str_detect(SubjID, "^S1"))

rt_ids <- read_csv("CSV_FILES/rt_nwords_frq.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(!is.na(Dim.1), !is.na(Dim.2), !SubjID %in% excluded) |>
  distinct(SubjID) |> pull(SubjID)

if (rerun_pca) {
  library(FactoMineR)  # the original scores were computed with FactoMineR::PCA
  pca_dat <- demo |>
    filter(SubjID %in% rt_ids) |>
    transmute(SubjID,
              z_vcb = as.numeric(scale(vcb_perc)),
              z_spl = as.numeric(scale(spl_perc)),
              z_art = as.numeric(scale(art_diff)))
  stopifnot(nrow(pca_dat) == 62, !anyNA(pca_dat))

  hdr("PCA on the analysed sample")
  print(cor.test(pca_dat$z_vcb, pca_dat$z_spl))
  print(cor.test(pca_dat$z_vcb, pca_dat$z_art))
  print(cor.test(pca_dat$z_spl, pca_dat$z_art))

  pca <- PCA(pca_dat[, c("z_vcb", "z_spl", "z_art")], scale.unit = TRUE,
             ncp = 2, graph = FALSE)
  print(pca$eig)
  load <- pca$var$coord               # loadings (correlations with components)
  scr  <- pca$ind$coord

  # Fix signs: vocabulary loads positively on Dim 1 (LP),
  #            spelling loads positively on Dim 2 (OS)
  if (load["z_vcb", 1] < 0) { load[, 1] <- -load[, 1]; scr[, 1] <- -scr[, 1] }
  if (load["z_spl", 2] < 0) { load[, 2] <- -load[, 2]; scr[, 2] <- -scr[, 2] }
  cat("\nLoadings after sign alignment:\n"); print(round(load, 2))

  scores <- tibble(SubjID = pca_dat$SubjID, LP = scr[, 1], OS = scr[, 2])
  cat("\nCorrelation of new with old scores (same participants):\n")
  old <- demo |> select(SubjID, Dim.1, Dim.2) |> inner_join(scores, by = "SubjID")
  print(round(c(LP = cor(old$Dim.1, old$LP), OS = cor(old$Dim.2, old$OS)), 3))
} else {
  scores <- demo |> transmute(SubjID, LP = Dim.1, OS = Dim.2) |>
    filter(!is.na(LP), !is.na(OS))
}
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================

rt_nw <- read_csv("CSV_FILES/rt_nwords_frq.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(correct == 1, !SubjID %in% excluded,
         !is.na(Dim.1), !is.na(Dim.2), !is.na(LogBF), !is.na(LogFS)) |>
  select(-any_of(c("Dim.1", "Dim.2"))) |>
  inner_join(scores, by = "SubjID") |>

         ItemID = factor(ItemID),

         logRT  = log(response_time),
         zLogBF = as.numeric(scale(LogBF)),
         zLogFS = as.numeric(scale(LogFS)))

erp <- read_csv("CSV_FILES/erp_fs_dmg.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>

  inner_join(scores, by = "SubjID") |>
  mutate(SubjID = factor(SubjID),
         chlabel = factor(chlabel),
         family_size = factor(family_size, levels = c("small", "large")),

         time_window = factor(time_window, levels = c("N250", "N400")))

contrasts(erp$time_window) <- c(-0.5, 0.5)
```

```{r}
hdr("RT model")
m_rt <- lmer(logRT ~ complexity + zLogBF + zLogFS + OS + LP +
               (1 + complexity | SubjID) + (1 | ItemID),
             data = rt_nw, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))
print(summary(m_rt))
print(eta_squared(m_rt, partial = TRUE))
print(r2_nakagawa(m_rt))
emm_rt <- summary(emmeans(m_rt, ~ complexity)) |>
  mutate(ms = exp(emmean), lo_ms = exp(lower.CL), hi_ms = exp(upper.CL))
print(emm_rt)
cat("Complex - Simple (ms):", round(diff(emm_rt$ms), 1), "\n")
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# 5. Separate ERP models
# =============================================================================
fit_window <- function(win, reml = TRUE, f = value ~ complexity * family_size * LP * OS +
                         (1 | SubjID) + (1 | SubjID:chlabel)) {
  lmer(f, data = filter(erp, time_window == win), REML = reml,
       control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))
}

probe <- function(m, win) {
  hdr(paste(win, "model"))
  print(summary(m))
  print(eta_squared(m, partial = TRUE))
  print(r2_nakagawa(m))

  # Four-way LRT (ML fits)
  f_full <- value ~ complexity * family_size * LP * OS + (1 | SubjID) + (1 | SubjID:chlabel)
  f_red  <- update(f_full, . ~ . - complexity:family_size:LP:OS)
  m_red_ml  <- fit_window(win, FALSE, f_red)
  m_full_ml <- fit_window(win, FALSE, f_full)
  cat("\n--", win, ": LRT for the four-way term --\n")
  print(anova(m_red_ml, m_full_ml))

  cat("\n--", win, ": complexity EMMs (averaged over family size) --\n")
  print(emmeans(m, ~ complexity))

  cat("\n--", win, ": complexity effect by family size, both dims at sample mean --\n")
  print(emmeans(m, ~ complexity | family_size,
                at = list(LP = lp_vals[2], OS = os_vals[2])) |>
          contrast("revpairwise"))

  cat("\n--", win, ": complexity effect averaged over FS, across OS (LP at mean) --\n")
  print(emmeans(m, ~ complexity | OS, at = list(OS = os_vals, LP = lp_vals[2])) |>
          contrast("revpairwise"))

  cat("\n--", win, ": OS slope of complexity effect at each LP (avg over FS) --\n")
  print(emtrends(m, ~ complexity | LP, var = "OS", at = list(LP = lp_vals)) |>
          contrast("revpairwise"))

  for (dim in c("LP", "OS")) {
    vals  <- if (dim == "LP") lp_vals else os_vals
    other <- if (dim == "LP") list(OS = os_vals[2]) else list(LP = lp_vals[2])
    at    <- c(setNames(list(vals), dim), other)

    cat("\n--", win, ": complexity effect by family size across", dim, "--\n")
    print(emmeans(m, as.formula(paste("~ complexity | family_size *", dim)),
                  at = at, nesting = NULL) |>
            contrast("revpairwise") |> summary(infer = TRUE))

    cat("\n--", win, ": cell means across", dim, "--\n")
    print(emmeans(m, as.formula(paste("~ complexity * family_size |", dim)),
                  at = at, nesting = NULL))

    cat("\n--", win, ": Complexity x FS contrast across", dim, "--\n")
    print(emmeans(m, as.formula(paste("~ complexity * family_size |", dim)),
                  at = at, nesting = NULL) |>
            contrast(interaction = "revpairwise"))

    cat("\n--", win, ":", dim, "slope of complexity effect by family size --\n")
    print(emtrends(m, ~ complexity | family_size, var = dim, at = other) |>
            contrast("revpairwise"))

    cat("\n--", win, ":", dim, "slope of the Complexity x FS contrast --\n")
    print(emtrends(m, ~ complexity * family_size, var = dim, at = other) |>
            contrast(interaction = "revpairwise"))
  }

  cat("\n--", win, ": Complexity x FS contrast over the LP x OS grid --\n")
  print(emmeans(m, ~ complexity * family_size | LP * OS,
                at = list(LP = lp_vals, OS = os_vals), nesting = NULL) |>
          contrast(interaction = "revpairwise") |> summary(infer = TRUE))

  cat("\n--", win, ": OS slope of Complexity x FS at each LP --\n")
  print(emtrends(m, ~ complexity * family_size | LP, var = "OS",
                 at = list(LP = lp_vals)) |> contrast(interaction = "revpairwise"))
  cat("\n--", win, ": LP slope of Complexity x FS at each OS --\n")
  print(emtrends(m, ~ complexity * family_size | OS, var = "LP",
                 at = list(OS = os_vals)) |> contrast(interaction = "revpairwise"))
}

m_n250 <- fit_window("N250"); probe(m_n250, "N250")
m_n400 <- fit_window("N400"); probe(m_n400, "N400")
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# 6. Combined model (both windows)
# =============================================================================
hdr("Combined N250 + N400 model")
re <- "(1 | SubjID) + (1 | SubjID:time_window) + (1 | SubjID:chlabel) + (1 | SubjID:chlabel:time_window)"
f_tw <- as.formula(paste("value ~ complexity * family_size * LP * OS * time_window +", re))

m_tw <- lmer(f_tw, data = erp, REML = TRUE, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))
print(summary(m_tw))

fixed_terms <- attr(terms(f_tw), "term.labels")
fixed_terms <- fixed_terms[!grepl("\\|", fixed_terms)]
has <- function(term, var) var %in% strsplit(term, ":")[[1]]
drop_window_terms <- function(var) {
  keep <- fixed_terms[!(sapply(fixed_terms, has, var = var) &
                        sapply(fixed_terms, has, var = "time_window"))]
  as.formula(paste("value ~", paste(keep, collapse = " + "), "+", re))
}
m_tw_ml <- lmer(f_tw, data = erp, REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))
m_noOSxTW <- lmer(drop_window_terms("OS"), data = erp, REML = FALSE,
                  control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))
m_noLPxTW <- lmer(drop_window_terms("LP"), data = erp, REML = FALSE,
                  control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))
cat("\n-- Omnibus: OS x window terms (8 df) --\n"); print(anova(m_noOSxTW, m_tw_ml))
cat("\n-- Omnibus: LP x window terms (8 df) --\n"); print(anova(m_noLPxTW, m_tw_ml))

lp_m <- lp_vals[2]; os_m <- os_vals[2]
cat("\n-- OS slope of complexity effect, by family size and window (LP at mean) --\n")
print(emtrends(m_tw, ~ complexity | family_size * time_window, var = "OS",
               at = list(LP = lp_m)) |> contrast("revpairwise"))
print(emtrends(m_tw, ~ complexity * time_window | family_size, var = "OS",
               at = list(LP = lp_m)) |> contrast(interaction = "revpairwise"))

cat("\n-- LP slope of complexity effect, by window (OS at mean, avg over FS) --\n")
print(emtrends(m_tw, ~ complexity | time_window, var = "LP",
               at = list(OS = os_m)) |> contrast("revpairwise"))
print(emtrends(m_tw, ~ complexity * time_window, var = "LP",
               at = list(OS = os_m)) |> contrast(interaction = "revpairwise"))

cat("\n-- LP slope of family size effect, by window (OS at mean, avg over complexity) --\n")
print(emtrends(m_tw, ~ family_size | time_window, var = "LP",
               at = list(OS = os_m)) |> contrast("revpairwise"))
print(emtrends(m_tw, ~ family_size * time_window, var = "LP",
               at = list(OS = os_m)) |> contrast(interaction = "revpairwise"))

cat("\n-- LP slope of complexity effect, by family size and window (OS at mean) --\n")
print(emtrends(m_tw, ~ complexity | family_size * time_window, var = "LP",
               at = list(OS = os_m)) |> contrast("revpairwise"))
print(emtrends(m_tw, ~ complexity * time_window | family_size, var = "LP",
               at = list(OS = os_m)) |> contrast(interaction = "revpairwise"))

sink()
saveRDS(list(m_rt = m_rt, m_n250 = m_n250, m_n400 = m_n400, m_tw = m_tw),
        sprintf("refit_option1_models_pca%s.rds", if (rerun_pca) "62" else "68"))
```

```{r}
cell <- dat |>
  group_by(SubjID, OS, LP, time_window, complexity, family_size) |>
  summarise(v = mean(value), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(cx = ifelse(complexity == "complex", 0.5, -0.5),
         fs = ifelse(family_size == "large", 0.5, -0.5))

eff <- cell |>
  group_by(SubjID, OS, LP, time_window) |>
  summarise(cx_eff   = sum(v * cx),            # complex - simple
            fs_eff   = sum(v * fs),            # large - small
            cxfs_eff = sum(v * cx * fs * 4),   # difference of differences
            .groups = "drop")

# Within each window (OS * LP to match the current model; ~59 residual df)
eff |> group_by(time_window) |>
  group_modify(~ broom::tidy(lm(cx_eff ~ OS * LP, data = .x)))

# Window difference (N400 - N250): the ...:time_window1 terms
eff_d <- eff |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = time_window, values_from = c(cx_eff, fs_eff, cxfs_eff)) |>
  mutate(cx_diff = cx_eff_N400 - cx_eff_N250,
         cxfs_diff = cxfs_eff_N400 - cxfs_eff_N250)
summary(lm(cx_diff ~ OS * LP, data = eff_d))
summary(lm(cxfs_diff ~ OS * LP, data = eff_d))
```
